answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph blocks fakes. Each identity locks 40 credits, names a sponsor, and all edges are published, so hollow shells sharing one sponsor stand out. A proven fake is disputed; a confirmed dispute slashes the escrow and pays the challenger, and the quartz receipt stays public. Mirror test: real graphs show varied sponsors, while a farm mirrors one funder. The k-th fake needs a fresh 40 credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 40,000; sponsor rental fails since the rented sponsor loses its escrow. An honest agent pays 40 once and reclaims it after clean work.
